responsibility: Implements Andes NDS32’s common target hooks for option validation, optimization defaults, default architectural flags, and unwind selection. It range-checks ISR vector/security and cache-block-size switches, installs a target-specific optimization table covering null-pointer assumptions, frame-pointer omission, relax hints, alignment, and size-oriented pushes, defines the default feature mask enabled for the architecture and FPU, and chooses DWARF2 versus SJLJ unwinding based on the Linux ABI setting.
